title: CAM Assist Manufacturing Assumptions Schema
description: Portable record of the manufacturing assumptions that influenced a manufacturing decision. A sidecar artifact that travels alongside a strategy package without mutating it. Informational only; grants no execution authority.

record_version.description: Semantic version of the manufacturing assumptions record format

package_reference.description: Reference to the package these assumptions relate to. Accepts federated_package_id, relative path, or package directory name.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this assumptions record was created

assumptions.description: List of manufacturing assumptions. Informational only; they record reasoning, not authorization.

category.description: Free-text category (e.g., tooling, material, fixturing, geometry, workholding)

rationale.description: Optional supporting rationale for the assumption

authority.description: Informational authority constraints. When present, every flag MUST be true.

is_informational.description: MUST be true. This record is informational only.

does_not_authorize_execution.description: MUST be true. This record does not authorize machine execution.

does_not_bypass_human_review.description: MUST be true. This record does not bypass required human review.
